title: Simple Vanilla Milkshake
description: A small vanilla shake made with everyday freezer and fridge staples.
ingredients_list: {"1/4 cup cold milk","1 cup vanilla ice cream","1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract"}
shopping_list: {"1/4 cup cold milk","1 cup vanilla ice cream","1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract"}
recipe_steps: {"Measure the milk into a blender. Let the ice cream stand for 2 minutes so it is easy to scoop.","Add the ice cream and the remaining measured ingredients. Cover and blend in short bursts until the mixture is smooth and pourable.","Turn off the blender before scraping down the sides if needed. Pour into one glass and enjoy right away."}
